findings.location: ...It was faithless Ahab who was told to ask of God a sign in the heavens or earth. In his pious reply he refused to \"tempt\" God. This lack of boldness... (source paragraph in Prayer Begets Power section)
findings.source_quote: It was faithless Ahab who was told to ask of God a sign in the heavens or earth. In his pious reply he refused to "tempt" God. This lack of boldness and abundance of fear is more tempting to God than the abundance of bitterness in our complaint for “there is no fear in love; but perfect love casteth out fear: because fear hath torment. He that feareth is not made perfect in love.” (1 John 4:18)
findings.suggested_fix: Fix the Russian grammar and maintain the original sense. В своём набожном ответе он отказался «искушать» Бога. Эта нехватка дерзновения и избыток страха..."
findings.translation_quote: Именно безверный Ахааву было велено просить у Бога знамение в небе или на земле. В своём набожном ответе он отказался «искушать» Бога. Эта нехватка дерзновения и избыток страха больше искушают Бога, чем обилие горечи в нашей жалобе, ибо “there is no fear in love; but perfect love casteth out fear: because fear hath torment. He that feareth is not made perfect in love.” (1 John 4:18)"
